_comment: The operator's published figures, EXPLICITLY IMPORTED into the snapshot.
capture.mjs archives what Jito publishes and records a hash in CLAIMS.tsv. That
is a transport record: it proves what bytes were served on a date. It does not
make those figures correct, and it must not flow into a published number on its
own. So an archived capture becomes a dashboard input only by being approved
here, by hand, with the archive path and hash it came from.
A stale claim is not an error — it is a finding, and the page says how old it is.
approvedBy: manual review against the archived capture
note: Figures move through the day, so they are captured and hashed: what was claimed on a date cannot be revised without record. Obtained via a rendering fetch — the public URL is a client-rendered shell and yields no figures over plain HTTP.
limitations: The dashboard is the operator's own, and is mutable: a Dune query can be edited retroactively or deleted.
Coverage begins 2026-07-24, about ten days after JIP-38 activation on 2026-07-13, so early activity is not represented.
These are claimed fees, not fees this project has traced on chain.
